    capacity = instance.get("capacity", instance.get("vehicle_capacity"))
    depot_id = instance.get("depot", instance.get("depot_id", 0))

    n = len(demands)

    def dist(i, j):
        xi, yi = coords[i]
        xj, yj = coords[j]
        dx = xi - xj
        dy = yi - yj
        return (dx * dx + dy * dy) ** 0.5

    customers = [i for i in range(n) if i != depot_id]

    d0 = [0.0] * n
